underlying_model: ECMWF ERA5 Reanalysis (~0.25 deg grid resolution)
grid_point_disclosure: Data represents ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis grid point (19.0861°N, 72.8529°E, elevation 6.0m), not a single physical weather station sensor.
citation: Open-Meteo.com Historical Weather Archive API (ERA5 Reanalysis by ECMWF). Data retrieved for Mumbai, Maharashtra, India (Requested: 19.076° N, 72.8777° E; ERA5 Grid Point: 19.086115° N, 72.85291° E) spanning 1950-01-01 to 2026-10-11.
limitations: ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis data represents a ~0.25° (~25–31 km) grid cell; localized coastal microclimates and urban heat island effects are smoothed.
Archive updates lag real-time by approximately 2–5 days due to ERA5 assimilation cycles.
Daily maximum reflects 2-meter air temperature over the calendar day in Asia/Kolkata timezone.
